request.description: Replace an existing log streaming destination. The update takes effect exactly as it would from the UI, using the same validation. Requires the `eventBusDestination:update` scope and the Log Streaming feature to be licensed. When destinations are managed via environment variables, the write is rejected with 409 and nothing is changed; reads still return the current values.
